sources.title: gpt2-xl: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview gpt2-xl is the 1.5 billion parameter version of GPT-2, a transformer-based causal language model created by OpenAI Community. The model uses a byte-level Byte Pair Encoding tokenizer with a vocabulary of 50,257 tokens and accepts input sequences of 1,024 consecutive tokens. It was pretrained on English text using a causal language modeling objective, trained to predict the next token ...
